patch_description: Restore the high-performing CRZ reverse chain from the second program (which achieved 0.93 validation accuracy) and insert a mid-RZ layer with two shared parameters to add phase flexibility. This three-stage RZ sandwich (pre-, mid-, post-entanglement) is inspired by the recommendation and adds only 2 parameters while preserving the proven parameter-sharing structure. Remove the non-beneficial RY reuse to keep the architecture clean.
